planets.name: MASCARA-1 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of MASCARA-1 with a 2.14-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: MASCARA-1 b was found in 2017 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around MASCARA-1. Its orbit and size follow Hooton et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
